seeds.world_rule: world seed of (instance, replication r) = runs.derive_seed(base_seed, set, instance, str(r)), shared by all scenarios, as in WP2b
seeds.forecast_rule: forecast seed of a checkpoint = runs.derive_seed(base_seed, 'forecast', set, instance, scenario, str(r), f'{f:g}'), shared by all forecasters (common random numbers)
